description: `include Comparable` plus a `<=>`, and the five operators it manufactures. Three of the eight slice files do exactly this (`Version`, `PkgVersion`, `Version::Token`), and it is the payoff of tier 10's mixin work: `Comparable` is a module in the MRO whose methods are *defined in terms of a method the including class supplies*, so typing `r < s` means dispatching to `Comparable#<`, whose body calls the receiver's own `<=>`. Nothing new in `Judge`; everything in the prelude the checker reads.
